title: Term Life Insurance Returned-Item Charge Rate
content:
**Fee schedule — Term Life Insurance returned items.** Within a grace remittance, the returned-item charge rate is set by the number of payments on the policy that were returned unpaid in the 12 months ending today, whatever the payment method:

| Payments returned unpaid in the 12 months ending today | Charge rate per item |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 25.00 |
| exactly 2 | 15.00 |
| 0 or 1 | nothing |

The count is taken from the returned-payment entries on the policy's activity history by the date of each return.

**Both sides of the thresholds (hypothetical).** One return in the 12 months — nothing per item. Two returns — 15.00 per item. Three returns — 25.00 per item. A return dated 13 months before today is outside the 12 months and is not counted.
